{"step":2,"file":"src/tests/fuzzing/fuzz_pkcs15_reader.c","function":"fuzz_get_chunk","line":52,"var":"data->Data / data->Size","code":"c_size = *((uint16_t *) data->Data);","note":"The first two attacker bytes determine the length of the next chunk, so later parsing decisions are fully input-driven.","depends_on":[{"on":1,"type":"data","via":"reader buffer"}]},
{"step":3,"file":"src/tests/fuzzing/fuzz_pkcs15_reader.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":156,"var":"card","code":"sc_connect_card(reader, &card);","note":"The synthetic reader is connected to OpenSC, causing the Coolkey card driver to initialize card state from the fuzzed APDU stream.","depends_on":[{"on":2,"type":"data","via":"reader callbacks"}]},
{"step":4,"file":"src/libopensc/card-coolkey.c","function":"coolkey_finish","line":1949,"var":"priv","code":"if (priv) { coolkey_free_private_data(priv); }","note":"During card teardown, the driver frees the private Coolkey state, including per-object payload buffers stored in the object list.","depends_on":[{"on":3,"type":"control","via":"driver lifecycle"}]},
{"step":5,"file":"src/libopensc/card-coolkey.c","function":"coolkey_free_private_data","line":810,"var":"o->data","code":"free(o->data); o->data = NULL;","note":"Each object's data buffer is released here; if the same object list is later torn down again, the same heap pointer is freed twice.","depends_on":[{"on":4,"type":"data","via":"priv->objects_list"}]},
{"step":6,"file":"src/tests/fuzzing/fuzz_pkcs15_reader.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":173,"var":"p15card","code":"sc_pkcs15_card_free(p15card);","note":"The PKCS#15 wrapper is freed after the driver teardown path has already run, triggering a second cleanup of the same Coolkey private data and reaching the double-free sink.","depends_on":[{"on":5,"type":"control","via":"card free"}]}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(p)
